# Status

This page owns one current claim: what annotated releases delivered. Everything else links to the
surface that can keep it current.

The table is generated by `cargo xtask status` from tags reachable from this commit. `status-check`
fails if it drifts; `git tag -n99` carries the complete annotated messages.

## Current work and verification

- [The planning store](../.engineering/planning/) is the validated record of accepted work and its
  lifecycle state.
- [The gap register](plan/gap-register.md) names every open gap and what closes it.
- [The vision](VISION.md) identifies proposals that no accepting surface has taken up.
- [`AGENTS.md` § Gate](../AGENTS.md#gate) carries the generated ordered gate list.
- `task check` is the measurement of the current tree. Its own output, not prose, owns suite and
  test counts.
